title: Secret-Shaped Member Names
description: One shared definition of which object member names look like they hold secret material. Families that must never carry a secret value reference noSecretMembers on the object, or secretShapedName when they need the test alone. Change it here only, so families do not drift on what counts as secret-shaped.

secretShapedName.description: Matches member names that name a secret value, in any letter case: value, secret(s), token(s), password, passwd, passphrase, pem, private key, or api key, as the whole name or after a separator. Written with character classes rather than an inline case flag so ECMA-262, Python and Rust regex engines agree.

noSecretMembers.description: Applied to an object: no member name may be secret-shaped.
